name: shipwright
description: Shipwright: a production-grade delivery workflow for Claude Code — planner, frontend-designer, fullstack-developer and manual-tester agents over a traceable backlog with evidence, plus mobile device tools. Works with Hindsight project memory and the context-mode plugin when they are installed.

plugins.name: shipwright-delivery
plugins.description: Planner-led delivery workflow: requirements to traceable tasks, static-first design hand-over, backend/integration development, manual verification with evidence, token-cost tracking, guard hooks, and optional project-level wiring for Hindsight memory and context-mode.

plugins.name: shipwright-devices
plugins.description: Pinned mobile-mcp MCP server so the designer and the manual tester can drive local iOS simulators and Android emulators (list, tap, type, read the screen).
